additional_info.subject: Re: ID0412859-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000884] Freq OCPP Offline CRM:00798002000
additional_info.body:
Hello Theo SALMON,
Based on the data available in the logs, I found that the connection was closed due to a missing Pong from the OCPP server &
Unexpected server response: 404
. I kindly request you to change the websocket ping interval from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.
It doesn’t seem to be a network issue, as the charger appears to have good network connectivity.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
